S1037.reason: A permitted assignment lets the investor enforce the buyer’s right to specific performance of a land contract; notice of the seller’s refusal, sophistication, and the zoning-driven value increase do not defeat that remedy.

S0107.reason: Immunity ratione personae attaches only to certain high officials during office and covers both their private and official acts, unlike functional immunity ratione materiae.

S0341.reason: Normal adult resting respiration is about 12–20 breaths per minute, so 14–16 sits in the normal range while 8–12 is low and 20–22 is high.
